The addition of elements Ti and C led to a microstructural transformation from coarse grains (0.3~0.7 μm in size) to ultrafine (~270 nm) and nanocrystalline (~100 nm) grains (See Fig. 3). Moreover, a high Hall-Petch coefficient was reported for this alloy [7]. Therefore, it can be deduced that grain-boundary strengthening played an important role in alloy strengthening.
Grain boundary strengthening and precipitation strengthening are the main strengthening mechanisms of alloy TC30.

These results suggest that the in situ synthesized TiC particles can strengthen the alloy during compression deformation; thus, precipitation strengthening also played an important role in alloy strengthening.
Grain boundary strengthening and precipitation strengthening are the main strengthening mechanisms of alloy TC30.

In addition, a small amount of Ti existed in the FCC solid solution (Table 1), which can also produce solution strengthening. This is because Ti has a larger atomic radius than that of the other elements in the alloy , which can lead to lattice distortion in the FCC solid solution .

Apart from grain-boundary strengthening and precipitation strengthening, twin-boundary strengthening, dislocation strengthening and solid-solution strengthening also contribute to the yield strength of alloy TC30.

The higher the dislocation density, the more obvious the effect of dislocation strengthening. Therefore, it is believed that dislocation strengthening also contributed to a certain yield strength value.

The improved mechanical properties of alloy TC30 result from contributions from several strengthening mechanisms: grain -boundary strengthening, precipitation strengthening, twin-boundary strengthening, dislocation strengthening, and solid -solution strengthening.

These results suggest that the in situ synthesized TiC particles can strengthen the alloy during compression deformation; thus, precipitation strengthening also played an important role in alloy strengthening.

The FeCoCrNiMn alloy with the addition of Ti and C (alloy TC30) developed a fine FCC solid solution matrix with distribution of carbides particles, resulting in an increase in hardness from 332 to 442 HV .
